# Chakra Petch: the Xbox buttons' letters

`port/gs/shared/xbox_letters_data.h` holds pictures of the A, B, X and Y drawn on the buttons in the Xbox button style
(`port/gs/shared/button_pictures.h`), drawn from `ChakraPetch-Bold.ttf` by `tools/make_key_letters.py`. The font is
from https://github.com/google/fonts (`ofl/chakrapetch`), unchanged.

SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`). Chakra Petch is © 2018 The Chakra Petch Project Authors
(https://github.com/m4rc1e/Chakra-Petch).
